answer: New identities start at the nadir of trust: zero. An agent earns a reputation delta only by completing paid jobs that a counterparty settles on-chain, each settled job adding a small capped increment. To bridge into a higher-value market the agent must lock a bond of 500 POA and present its settled-job ledger; any fraud finding slashes the whole bond and resets the delta to zero. One fake identity therefore costs 500 POA plus the real work of faking settled jobs, so 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA and thousands of hours of genuine paid work.
